title: Linear Combination Properties of Spectral Phasors Allow Thermodynamic Analysis of Reversible Denaturation of Multidomain and Membrane Proteins.
authors: Recoulat Angelini, Alvaro A; Malacrida, Leonel; Gonzalez Flecha, F Luis
one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于光谱相量的热力学分析框架，用于量化多结构域和膜蛋白的变性过程，虽涉及蛋白质构象变化分析，但核心是荧光光谱数据处理而非结构计算建模，方法上无AI或物理模拟贡献。
abstract: Denaturation of small globular proteins is often described as a reversible two-state transition between native and denatured conformations. Conversely, multidomain and membrane proteins frequently populate several partially folded intermediate states during denaturation. Traditional thermodynamic analysis of fluorescence intensity often fails to reliably identify these intermediate states. Alternatively, spectral phasors provide an effective model-free way to monitor these complex conformational changes by resolving overlapping fluorescence signals with small differences in the position or shape of the spectra. Nevertheless, converting phasor trajectories into quantitative thermodynamic information remains challenging when quantum yields do not remain constant during a given process, thus limiting their application to protein stability studies. In this work, we introduce a thermodynamic framework for quantifying protein stability from phasor trajectories. We validate this formalism using simulated spectral data generated from two- and three-state transitions, including changes in fluorescence quantum yields, successfully recovering the thermodynamic parameters used to generate the simulations. Additionally, we applied this approach to analyze published data on urea-induced unfolding of E. coli Outer Membrane Protein A. Phasor analysis identified a two-state transition, and the thermodynamic parameters agreed well with those obtained from total fluorescence intensity, supporting the validity of the proposed approach. Finally, applying this framework to the SDS-induced denaturation of Archaeoglobus fulgidus Cu(I)-transport ATPase enabled a complete thermodynamic characterization of the three transitions identified by phasor analysis of intrinsic fluorescence, which could not be resolved using fluorescence intensity alone. This formalism establishes fluorescence spectral phasors as a powerful quantitative approach for protein stability analysis.
abstract_zh: 小分子球状蛋白的变性通常被描述为天然构象与变性构象之间可逆的两态转变。相反，多结构域蛋白和膜蛋白在变性过程中经常出现多个部分折叠的中间态。传统的荧光强度热力学分析往往无法可靠地识别这些中间态。作为一种替代方法，光谱相量 (spectral phasors) 提供了一种有效的无模型方式，通过解析光谱位置或形状差异很小的重叠荧光信号来监测这些复杂的构象变化。然而，当量子产率在某一给定过程中不保持恒定时，将相量轨迹转换为定量热力学信息仍然具有挑战性，从而限制了其在蛋白质稳定性研究中的应用。在本工作中，我们引入了一个从相量轨迹量化蛋白质稳定性的热力学框架。我们使用由两态和三态转变（包括荧光量子产率变化）生成的模拟光谱数据验证了该形式体系，成功恢复了用于生成模拟的热力学参数。此外，我们将该方法应用于分析已发表的大肠杆菌外膜蛋白A的尿素诱导去折叠数据。相量分析识别出两态转变，且热力学参数与从总荧光强度获得的结果吻合良好，支持了所提出方法的有效性。最后，将该框架应用于激烈火球菌 (Archaeoglobus fulgidus) Cu(I) 转运 ATPase 的 SDS 诱导变性，使得能够对通过内源荧光相量分析识别出的三个转变进行完整的热力学表征，而仅使用荧光强度无法解析这些转变。该形式体系确立了荧光光谱相量作为蛋白质稳定性分析的强大定量方法。
